follow-up time: Until the publication date of the study
cohort: Five infant patients (3 male, 2 female) with rare FLNC gene variants, median age of 3 months (range: 19 days to 30 months).
finding: Clinical exome sequencing identified rare FLNC variants in five infant patients, contributing to the early diagnosis of cardiomyopathy (2 restrictive cardiomyopathy, 2 dilated cardiomyopathy, and 1 arrhythmia) and all patients survived to the publication date.
